$comment: Performance budgets (docs/05_backlog.md section 9.3, M1-CI-05; docs/engineering/ci.md). p95 server-side latency in ms under PERF_CONNECTIONS concurrent connections. `requires: registry` entries are SKIPPED (not failed) while the route answers 404/405 or the seeded data is missing, unless PERF_REQUIRE_REGISTRY=1 (set it once M1-REG-07/08 have landed). `health` is a proposed budget of this repo (not in the backlog): the liveness-plus-DB-round-trip endpoint through PgBouncer.

endpoints.name: health
endpoints.description: GET /v1/health (API + PgBouncer + Postgres round trip, no auth)

endpoints.name: asset-list
endpoints.description: GET /v1/assets, first page of the registry list (M1-REG-07; backlog budget: p95 < 500 ms on 2 x 50,000 assets)

endpoints.name: asset-search
endpoints.description: GET /v1/assets?q=<tag or name of a seeded asset> (trigram search; backlog budget: p95 < 200 ms)

endpoints.name: tag-lookup
endpoints.description: GET /v1/assets?tag=<exact tag> (barcode scan path; backlog budget: p95 < 150 ms)
